message.content:
This is a partial assembly of a smartphone (display, battery, cameras, etc.) that lacks the main PCBA, so it is not a complete or essentially complete phone. It is therefore classified as a part of the phone. Parts of telephones for cellular networks fall under 8517.70. The relevant subheading is 8517.70.00 with statistical suffixes: 8517.71 covers antennas, and 8517.79 covers other parts. Under HTSUS, 8517.70.00 breaks down into 8517.70.0000 for parts, and the older 8517.70.0030 and similar suffixes were deleted. Some CBP rulings on similar Samsung display assemblies with front case and battery classify them under 8517.70.0000. The rulings tend to place the assembly in 8517.70.0000 as parts of cellular phones, so I'll use that.

{"hts_code": "8517.70.0000", "reason": "The front case/battery/display sub-assembly lacks the main PCBA so it is not an essentially complete phone, and it is classified as a part of a cellular smartphone under heading 8517, subheading 8517.70."}
